text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

SOYBEAN SALE - South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp has bought 20,000 tonnes of U.S. No 2 soybeans at basis over November futures on CBOT. The company bought from Marubeni Corp for shipment in early October from the U.S. Gulf. Arrival was set for the western port city of Inchon. Traders said the soybean purchase was made at around $320 to $325 per tonne, FOB.
WHEAT SALES - CCC purchased on September 11 a total of 19,860 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat for export distribution to Ethiopia amd Pakistan. Shipment is September 25-October 20.

WHEAT SALES - The Japanese Food Agency said it had bought 60,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, 20,000 of Canadian wheat, 40,000 of Australian wheat, 16,000 of Canadian barley and 20,000 of Australian barley at its weekly Thursday tender. All purchases are for November shipment.

- Four South Korean feed mill companies, including Cheiljedang Corp and Miwon Co Ltd, late on Wednesday bought 50,000 tonnes of Canadian feed wheat from Mitsubishi Corp, traders said. The wheat was purchased at $162.80 per tonne, C&F. Shipment was set for November 10-30, for arrival by December 15 at the western port city of Inchon.

WHEAT TENDER - Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade offered 50,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale, a spokesman said. An international call had been issued, setting September 17 as the final date to receive price offers. Confirmation would be made on September 18. The amount would be ready for shipment from Oct 15 to Nov 14.

- Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade offered 100,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale for November shipment. October 1 was the final date for offers. Confirmation would be made on October 2.
WHEAT TENDERS - Egypt will tender on September 13 for the import of 50,000 tonnes of French soft wheat for shipment between October 15 and October 31, European traders said.

- Algeria has launched a tender for the import of 100,000 tonnes of U.S. and/or Canadian durum wheat for shipment between the second half of October and the first half of December, European grain traders said.

- The CCC said it is seeking up to 45,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat, maximum moisture 13.5 percent, under the export donation program to Ethiopia. Shipment period is slated for November 1-25 and offers are due by September 19.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC seeks 25,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the export donation program for Bosnia. Shipment is set for Oct 5-31 and bids are due on September 17.
- The CCC seeks up to 4,410 tonnes of U.S. No.2 soft red winter or soft white wheat for donation to Senegal. Shipment period is set for October 5-31 and offers are due by Sept 18.

WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC seeks 23,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat for donation to Honduras. The deal includes 5,000 tonnes NS/DNS wheat and 3,000 tonnes soft red winter wheat set for November 1-25 shipment. It also includes 9,500 NS/DNS wheat and 6,000 tonnes SRW wheat for Dec 10-30. Offers due Sept 11.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC will tender on Sept 12 for 8,000 tonnes of U.S. SRW wheat for donation to Jamaica.

- South Korea's Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd and Cheiljedang Corp invited tenders for 21,500 tonnes of U.S. No.2 wheat on Friday, traders said. Cheiljedang invited tenders for 9,000 tonnes, all at basis over March futures on CBOT. Dongah tendered for 12,500 tonnes on normal purchase conditions. Shipment was set for January 1-31 to Pusan and Ulsan.
- South Korea's Dae Han Flour Mills Co Ltd seeks 12,500 tonnes of U.S. No.2 wheat by 2 p.m. on Friday. Shipment was set for January 15 to February 15 to Inchon.
CORN TENDER - Jordan is to seek 50,000 tonnes of U.S. Number 3 yellow corn for shipment in first half of November. Offers must be received by September 25.
- The CCC seeks up to 4,280 tonnes of U.S. No.2 yellow corn under the export donation program to Angola. Shipment period is slated for Oct 5-31 and offers are due by Sept 18.
RICE TENDER - The Export Corporation of Pakistan invited bids by Sunday for the sale of 30,000 tonnes of basmati rice.
- Ivory Coast will seek 29,000 tonnes of PL-480 long grain brown rice for Oct 15-Nov 15 and/or Nov 15-Dec 15 shipment. Bids are due by Sept 11.
